spline.end_condition: zero second derivative; unreported by authors

geometry_assumptions: Fixed 18 x 25 mm footprint; clear branch length = 25 - 2*manifold_width mm
18 mm total manifold span includes two 0.25 mm port extensions
Contact reference is uniform 1 mm branches at the same manifold width
other_closures: Inlet 15 mL/min interpreted as liquid volume flow, total mixture flow Q/0.9
Springer membrane ionic conductivity with Bruggeman CL fraction
Unity gas and water activities at the 1 atm reference pressure
Anode reversible heat iVol*T*(-0.0009 V/K), zero cathode reversible heat
Eq.18 water diffusivity with configurable multiplier; Eq.17 prefactor is ambiguous
No additional interphase drag correlation; paper does not specify one
PTL Leverett relation extended to CL using CL porosity/permeability; CL capillary closure is unreported
fidelity_limits: Author CAD, constitutive inputs, spline end conditions and area tolerance unavailable
Low-order donor-cell phase transport; coarse mesh results require refinement
Separate phase enthalpy advection in the LTE energy equation
Published optimized layouts and reported performance values are not reproduced by definition
Channel permeability is an unreported input; 1e-6 m^2 is a dimensional estimate based on the 1 mm channel height, requiring sensitivity checks
Superficial phase momentum follows Eq.13; collocated finite-volume pressure/phase coupling and donor-cell transport differ from the author discretization

solver.linear: Eigen SparseLU serial; local SparseLU-preconditioned GMRES MPI
solver.outer: Local pseudo-time with phase-depletion retries, optional voltage continuation, and safeguarded Anderson acceleration after momentum settles; phase acceptance unchanged
solver.output_time: outer iteration count, not physical seconds
solver.momentum: Separate superficial phase velocities; conservative steady-equivalent form of Eq.13 using Eqs.11-12, full viscous stress and Darcy drag
solver.phase_mobility: Cubic upwind relative permeability; harmonic interpolation of the remaining momentum coefficient
solver.velocity_correction: Full relaxed momentum predictor followed by pressure projection and diagonal cell correction using a physical Gauss pressure force
solver.wall_stress: Zero face velocity at internal no-slip walls; full Newtonian normal stress; symmetric active masks across processor interfaces
solver.initial_voltage: Requested voltage by default; min(initial_voltage, cell_voltage) if a lower warm-up is configured
solver.jacobian_check: Separate scaled pressure/saturation finite-difference directions with fixed donors only during this diagnostic; relative-error limit 1e-4; actual nonlinear fluxes retain unfrozen donors
solver.initial_state: Finished, hash-verified same-geometry case; internal volume fields and saved face fluxes copied into a new case, fresh prescribed volume-field boundary conditions and inlet fluxes; no inherited qualification
solver.pressure_gradient: Geometric face-pressure interpolation within one material; physical half-cell Darcy resistance weights at material interfaces; independent of numerical pseudo-time and equation relaxation
solver.pressure_relaxation_fluxes: Conservative full-projection face fluxes are retained; cell pressure and its physical force are relaxed for steady SIMPLE iteration

pseudo_courant.growth_requires: iteration>50, phase momentum residuals<.005, field change<.01
pseudo_courant.reduction: halve toward .5 if momentum>.02 or field change>.1

optimization.stop_interpretation: successive distinct feasible evaluations after initial simplex
optimization.maximum_attempts: user-supplied budget includes baseline and failures
optimization.resume: deterministic journal replay without repeated CFD

mesh.topology: Fixed subdivisions for channel and rib segments at each mesh level; smooth width changes preserve cell connectivity
